metric: predeclared primary union-cluster TV; sensitivities and fixed-k2 retained separately
rank_rule: descending task mean TV; report tied rank intervals; top5 requires worst rank<=5

verdict_text: TV fails the user-specified joint detector criterion and is dropped from the paper as a decision-change metric. Group separation alone does not rescue failed task8/9 localization.
